BEIJING, Feb.  06, 2020  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Micron Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: MU), today announced it has delivered the world’s first low-power DDR5 DRAM in mass production to be used in the soon-to-be-released Xiaomi Mi 10 smartphone. As Xiaomi’s memory technology partner, Micron provides LPDDR5 DRAM with superior power efficiency and faster data access speeds to meet growing consumer demand for artificial intelligence (AI) and 5G functionality in smartphones.
